comment: Source read at commit 1da72f2. src/ and res/ have changed only once, at the initial release c9af887, so every 2.0.0 commit carries the same code; 1da72f2 and a176950 are the two whose plugin.json is byte-identical to the installed one, and all four installed res/ SVGs hash to the blobs there. THE BRIGHTNESS KNOB SETS TWO THINGS. Invaders.cpp:149 remaps the knob's 0 to 1 into 0.5 to 1, line 172 uses that to set the phosphor decay from 0.88 to 0.96 per frame, and line 341 squares it for the master brightness, with line 346 adding up to 1.5 more once the remapped value passes 0.75 — which is the knob's own default position, so the overdrive starts at the centre of the travel. gates[3] is declared at line 102 and never used: the fourth jack is read as a level at line 152 rather than as an edge. The random generator is seeded to 1 at line 106 and never reseeded, so a freshly placed module always draws the same sequence of invader shapes and fires its lasers down the same columns. THE WIKI AND THE CODE DISAGREE ON JACK 3: the wiki says it 'overlays a white noise flash', but lines 289 to 298 invert the bright pixels and then pull every pixel a third of the way towards a flat 0.85 grey each frame for eight frames. There is no noise in it. The maker named none of the four inputs, so Rack shows an empty tooltip on each; the two parameters are named Brightness & Overdrive and Color/Hue, and the panel prints a sun symbol over the first and COLOR over the second. The wiki at https://github.com/hrubix/Invaders/wiki is the only documentation; the README is a placeholder pointing at it.
